fields.label: Contact name
fields.description: Private contact display name used for exact duplicate review.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: Optional private email normalized to a lowercase address and used for duplicate review.

fields.label: Organization name
fields.description: Optional private organization name resolved to one exact existing resource or omitted and flagged.

fields.label: Requested role
fields.description: Optional private Role request accepted only by exact case-insensitive match to the current schema.

fields.label: Requested status
fields.description: Optional private Status request accepted only from the current schema.

fields.label: Requested disposition
fields.description: Optional private relationship disposition accepted only by exact current-option match; vague supportive language is not promoted automatically.

fields.label: Requested authority labels
fields.description: Optional private Authority requests; every retained value must match the current schema.

fields.label: Requested tags
fields.description: Optional private Tags requests; unmatched values are omitted and flagged rather than created as provider options.

fields.label: Telegram
fields.description: Optional private Telegram identity stored as bounded plain contact text.

fields.label: Signal
fields.description: Optional private Signal identity stored as bounded plain contact text.

fields.label: GitHub
fields.description: Optional private GitHub identity stored as bounded plain contact text.

fields.label: Timezone (UTC)
fields.description: Optional private timezone text; no timezone is inferred from location or email.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Optional private factual source description for how the contact was encountered.
